name: Chimeric-Chimera
body:
Your hodge-podge of parts becomes a coordinated symphony of physicality.

Prerequisite(s): Dai’Chi.

Benefit(s): You may gain one of the following dai’chi racial traits that you do not already possess: viper tail, strong wings, dragon blood, goat-footed, or lion’s roar.

Special: This may be taken multiple times. Each time it grants a different racial trait.
